evidence.reference_title: A retrospective study on biotinidase deficiency: analysis of the Eastern Anatolia region patient cohort.
evidence.snippet: The mutations that caused the most significant decrease in enzyme activity were c.410G > A p.Arg137His, c.38_delinsTCC p.Cys13phefs*36, and c.1535C > T p.Thr512Met
